build.//: Thin remote shell — no local frontend to build. Both dev and prod load the already-https cowboy UI served by caddy on the tailnet. A URL (not a path) for frontendDist tells Tauri to skip bundling assets and load remote.

security.//: csp null: let the remote cowboy UI's own response headers govern; we inject nothing. The remote origin gets NO Tauri IPC access (dangerousRemoteDomainIpcAccess is intentionally unset) — this shell only provides the native WebView.

bundle.//icon: Generated on the Mac via `cargo tauri icon ../web/public/icon-512.png` into src-tauri/icons/.
